arguments:
{"script":"set -euo pipefail
mkdir -p temp_workspace_check
# 2. raw listing
find /working -print 2>/dev/null > temp_workspace_check/raw_listing.txt || true
# 3. extract basenames exactly "workspace"
awk -F"/" '$NF=="workspace"{print}' temp_workspace_check/raw_listing.txt > temp_workspace_check/candidates.txt || true
# 4. record file-type metadata
: > temp_workspace_check/candidates_with_type.txt
while IFS= read -r p; do
  [ -z "$p" ] && continue
  if [ -e "$p" ] || [ -L "$p" ]; then
    t=$(stat -c '%F' "$p" 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)
  else
    t=missing
  fi
  printf '%s\t%s\n' "$p" "$t" >> temp_workspace_check/candidates_with_type.txt
done < temp_workspace_check/candidates.txt
# 5. verify entries against current filesystem state
: > temp_workspace_check/verified_candidates.txt
while IFS=$'\t' read -r p t; do
  [ -z "$p" ] && continue
  if [ -e "$p" ] || [ -L "$p" ]; then
    current=$(stat -c '%F' "$p" 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)
    if [ "$current" = "$t" ]; then
      printf '%s\t%s\n' "$p" "$t" >> temp_workspace_check/verified_candidates.txt
    fi
  fi
done < temp_workspace_check/candidates_with_type.txt
# 6. produce concise summary
cp temp_workspace_check/verified_candidates.txt temp_workspace_check/summary.txt || true
# Final decision: is there any verified regular file named "workspace"?
if grep -P '\tregular file$' -q temp_workspace_check/verified_candidates.txt; then
  echo yes
else
  echo no
fi
"}
